quizzes.title: Quiz 1
quizzes.description: One question at a time, with an instant right/wrong check and a running score as you go. Best for your first pass through the question bank.

quizzes.title: Interactive Quiz
quizzes.description: A larger, expanded pool with extra scenario variations. Pick a custom question range to drill, and review every wrong answer at the end.

quizzes.title: Practice Exam
quizzes.description: The full mock exam: every question on one scrollable page, with domain filters and a final score broken down by domain — the closest simulation of test day.
